tools.name: Coding Fleet
tools.description: CodingFleet is a comprehensive AI-powered coding assistant platform that helps developers write, understand, convert, and improve code across 90+ programming languages and frameworks. It streamlines the coding process with tools like Code Generator, Code Assistant, Code Converter, and Unit Test Generator.
bullets: AI-powered coding assistant for 90+ programming languages and frameworks
Code generation, conversion, and improvement features
Unit testing and code optimization support

tools.name: Amazon CodeWhisperer
tools.description: Amazon CodeWhisperer is an AI-powered coding companion developed by AWS that helps developers write code faster and more securely by providing real-time code suggestions, snippets, and security scans within popular IDEs.
bullets: AI-powered code suggestions and security scans
Real-time code suggestions and snippets
Security vulnerability detection and prevention

tools.name: Aider
tools.description: Aider.ai is an open-source AI-powered coding assistant that allows developers to collaborate with large language models like GPT-4 directly from the command line.
bullets: Open-source AI-powered coding assistant
Collaboration with large language models like GPT-4
Conversational programming, code editing, and refactoring support

tools.name: Sourcery
tools.description: Sourcery is an AI-powered coding assistant specifically designed to help developers write cleaner, more efficient Python code.
bullets: AI-powered code refactoring and optimization
Real-time code suggestions and docstring generation
Automated code review and best practice enforcement

tools.name: Replit Ghostwriter
tools.description: Replit Ghostwriter is an AI-powered coding assistant integrated into the Replit online IDE.
bullets: AI-powered code suggestions and autocomplete
Debugging help and natural language explanations

tools.name: Codex (OpenAI)
